name: ESP8266 RTOS SDK Devcontainer
postStartCommand:
bash -lc "set -e; \
    mkdir -p ~/.ssh; chmod 700 ~/.ssh; \
    ssh-keygen -R host.docker.internal >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; \
    ssh-keygen -R 192.168.65.254 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; \
    ssh-keyscan -H host.docker.internal 2>/dev/null >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts || true; \
    chmod 600 ~/.ssh/known_hosts; \
    if [ ! -f ~/.ssh/config ]; then \
      cat > ~/.ssh/config <<'EOF'
\
Host mac-host
\
  HostName host.docker.internal
\
  User ${HOST_USER}
\
  IdentitiesOnly yes
\
  IdentityAgent ${SSH_AUTH_SOCK}
\
EOF
\
      chmod 600 ~/.ssh/config; \
    fi; \
    if [ ! -S ${SSH_AUTH_SOCK} ]; then \
      echo '[devcontainer] WARNING: SSH agent socket not found at' ${SSH_AUTH_SOCK}; \
      echo '[devcontainer] On macOS run: ssh-add -l (and ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 if needed)'; \
    fi"
postCreateCommand:
bash -lc 'set -e; \
    git submodule update --init Deps/ESP8266_RTOS_SDK; \
    cd "$IDF_PATH"; \
    git submodule update --init components/coap/libcoap; \
    cd components/coap/libcoap; \
    git config -f .gitmodules submodule.ext/tinydtls.url https://github.com/eclipse-tinydtls/tinydtls.git; \
    git submodule sync --recursive; \
    git submodule update --init --recursive ext/tinydtls; \
    python -m pip install --user -r "$IDF_PATH/requirements.txt"'
